scenes.title: A word that can return to its speaker
Two roads, six works, and the return through the loop
Images that retain the relation they expose
The black sun and the radiating star
Keeping the opening in the form

expression:return-of-zero:roz-mytheme-ta.title: checkmate — and "Another game?"
the husk — what comes back when knowing fixes on its object
"The 0 is the One, the 1 is the All!" — FT-P04
the institutions which must not devour the humanity that made and makes them (FT-P07)
P0 — the fork: cancellation beside generation
P0 — 4+2: the four pairings with the generating two retained
P3 — two through the Two Ones, ring around the Rosie, falling down through the loop
P4 — "we forgot that one really is two"; humility as prerequisite of precision
P5 — "to find the limit, so, to speak" — the pauses making the finding an act of language
the fish — describing the water it lives in
the cage / the window — both need the frame
the kaleidoscope — a word as local orbital centre
the Necker cube — reversal held by context, not a fourth face
the broken token — each half referring to the absent other
the erased dots — the outer form kept, the reciprocity gone
the black sun — intake without renewal
the four rings — Neptune's distance, Jupiter's gravity, Mercury's fixers, the corona's mutual exposure
the radiating star — what reaches the centre becoming available outward
cynicism → exhaustion → blankness — the field ready for re-inscription
city · bomb · surveillance · counterfeit — three distinct failures (destruction, capture, forged source)
God as Other — source exceeding possession
shadow as other-self · friend as my-self's-other · alien/enemy as externalised uncertainty
the returned shoe — "Let the shoe fit / But return it" (FT-P23)
recursive Bimba — a reference genuinely occupying the local original's office, pratibimba in the wider relation
